steps.detail: value box percentages add up to 100.0% of the picture
value view shows 5 grey levels (asked for 5)
dragged a crop frame over the picture: 1200x800 became 720x480 (60% x 60% of the original)
10 colour levels, 10 Kubelka-Munk recipes from the palette, mean colour difference dE 2.1
Cobalt Blue + Lemon Yellow mix to [41, 132, 131], hue 195 degrees (green)
recipes are worked out with Some(Spectral) Kubelka-Munk
hovering the mixing model explains it: "Spectral: each paint's colour becomes a smooth reflectance curve"
RGB model chosen: 10 recipes worked out again, mean dE 3.0
spectral model chosen again: 10 recipes, mean dE 2.1; Crimson + Phthalo Green mix to [63, 63, 65], a near-neutral grey (chroma 1.3)
the Mix / Glaze switch is drawn and explains itself: "Glaze: transparent layers, each painted once the one below is dry."

Glaze chosen: 10 recipes, 10 with glazes (only transparent or half-transparent paints, at most 3 paints, colour = its layers), mean dE 1.2; e.g. Yellow Deep, then Phthalo Green (full strength / full strength)
Mix chosen again: every recipe is a mixture, no glazes
clicked spot [150, 149, 169] got a recipe: 4 Ultramarine Blue + 3 Crimson + 2 Phthalo Green
hovering the clicked spot's match label shows the dE explanation: "Colour match: excellent  (dE 1.6)"
Fibonacci spiral drawn with 336 line segments
golden ratio grid drawn with 4 lines at 38.2% and 61.8%
grid drawn with 8 lines
value scale, level counts, palette, clicked-spot recipe, recipe list and rule-of-thirds overlay are drawn
contour view draws lines on paper: 3.7% of the pixels are lines (detail 5)
contour lines drawn over the original picture (12760 pixels)
Export PDF wrote a 209 KB brochure with 5 pages and 4 pictures (original, values, contours, colour levels), ending with the match rating legend
Export PDF in Glaze mode: 209 KB brochure with a "Glazing recipes" page and the method in its settings
created "Acrylic 3" (Acrylic) with paints: Hansa Yellow Light PY3 Transparent; Crimson PR206 Transparent
"Save to my colour library" kept Crimson PR206 (brand "My colours", for Acrylic) and opened it in the editor
edited to Opera Rose PR122 by "Test Brand", Half-transparent, for Watercolor + Acrylic; the palette's paint stays "Crimson" (palettes keep copies)
"+ New colour" added "New colour" (brand "Test Brand" from the last edit, for Acrylic); Save kept it and closed the editor
a colour just added shows Cancel and Save instead of Delete and Done
Cancel took the new colour out again (2 colours in your library)
brand filter "Test Brand" lists 2 colours: Opera Rose, New colour
use filter Oil lists 45 colours, all for oil (your two watercolor/acrylic colours are hidden)
grouped by use: Acrylic (1), Watercolor + Acrylic (1), Any paint (45)
grouped by brand: Test Brand, General; Edit only on your own colours, not on the general ones
Edit opened Opera Rose; "Add to palette" added Opera Rose PR122
Delete (clicked twice) removed Opera Rose from the library (1 left); the palette keeps its copy
switched to acrylic: palette "Acrylic 1", recipes recomputed, lighter colours use white paint

acrylic palette "Acrylic 1" glazed: 8 of 10 recipes use glazes of transparent paints over an opaque first layer; e.g. Yellow Ochre, then Phthalo Blue, then Burnt Umber (no white; glazes: strong / thin)
the recent menu lists one picture and "Clear recent list"
picked "palettecraft-selftest.png" from the recent menu and it opened as "palettecraft-selftest.png" (list kept in memory only)
after each change the picture's settings are kept in the recent list
reopened the picture with its own settings: Value levels view, 3 value levels, Grid overlay, crop Some((60, 40, 300, 240)), clicked spot restored
the × removed the picture from the recent list and the menu stayed open, now empty
an open picture shows a Close button beside its name
Close closed the picture: no picture, levels, recipes or clicked spot left; Open picture... is still there
